description.narrative: Det övergripande målet med insatsen är att stärka individers och landsbygdssamhällens motståndskraft mot ekonomiska, klimatrelaterade och konfliktrelaterade chocker samt minska riskerna för skyddsrelaterade hot. Insatsen genomförs av ett NGO-konsortium med IRC som lead.

The overall objective of the contribution is to strengthen the resilience of individuals and rural communities’ resilience to economic, climatic, and conflict related shocks and reduce compounding protection risks. The project is implemented through a NGO consortium with IRC as lead.

The overall objective of the project is to strengthen the resilience of individuals and rural communities resilience to economic, climatic, and conflict-related shocks and reduce compounding protection risks. Towards this end, the four results of the project are:
1. Shock-affected households have improved capacity and resources to subsist (produce for self-consumption) or generate an income in a resilient manner.
2. Shock-affected communities have strengthened capacity to manage natural resources sustainable and peacefully.
3. The capacity of shock-affected communities to manage localised conflict over natural resources is enhanced.
4. Those experiencing harm benefit from improved community safety, well being, self-coping capacities, and access to services.
